Event dates, times, age guidance, prices, registration requirements, availability, programmes and venue details can change after publication. Please verify important information directly with the linked organiser, venue or official source before travelling, registering or purchasing.

Product deals are selected editorially from publicly available retailer information. Prices, discounts, reference prices, stock, delivery conditions and availability may change at any time. A listed deal does not guarantee continued availability or the lowest market price.

Links to organisers, venues, retailers and other third-party websites are provided for convenience. Gugu Basel does not control those websites and is not responsible for their content, availability, purchases, bookings, services, terms or privacy practices.

Gugu Basel is not an event organiser, ticket seller or retailer unless expressly stated otherwise.

Privacy

Gugu Basel does not intentionally collect personal data directly through this website.

Technical data may nevertheless be processed automatically by the website hosting and infrastructure providers when the site is accessed. Depending on the provider, this may include information such as an IP address, browser or device information, access time and technical server logs used to deliver, operate and secure the website.

Gugu Basel currently provides contact through Instagram DM rather than a website contact form. Information you choose to send through Instagram is processed under Instagram’s own terms and privacy practices.

The website contains external links to Instagram, event organisers, venues, retailers and other third-party websites. Clicking an external link takes you to a third-party service. Its own privacy policy and data-processing practices then apply.

Gugu Basel does not intentionally use advertising trackers or analytics scripts in the current page code. No website contact form is used. Hosting or third-party services may nevertheless process technical information necessary to provide their services.

If Gugu Basel later introduces analytics, non-essential cookies, embedded third-party services, advertising technology, affiliate tracking or other technologies that materially change how personal data is processed, this Privacy notice will be updated and any additional transparency or consent measures required for that implementation will be introduced.

Gugu Basel does not sell personal data to advertisers or other third parties.
